items.author: vishalraj1
items.descZh: ShadowDiff 是一个专为 AI 重构遗留代码设计的双重流量影子测试引擎，旨在解决 AI 重构过程中代码测试的复杂性，确保重构后的代码稳定性和可靠性。其核心功能包括实时流量镜像，用于在生产环境外模拟真实流量；语义差异分析，用于智能检测代码变化；以及自动 LLM 回归测试生成，提升测试自动化水平。亮点在于其集成的自动化流程，但原文未提供具体性能数字，如处理速度或准确率。适用场景包括企业级软件开发中，对遗留系统进行 AI 驱动的重构和验证，以降低风险并提高效率。
items.quote: 用于 AIRefactored 遗留代码的 DualTraffic Shadow 测试引擎 实时流量测试、语义差异和自动 LLM 回归测试生成
items.titleZh: 展示 HN：ShadowDiff——面向 AI 迁移后端的影子测试与 SQL 差异比对工具

I have a free demo available that goes up to drawing a triangle, while I'm still working on the r
items.author: icedlatte
items.descZh: Hello Triangle是一款创新的教育类游戏，旨在通过交互式电路连接帮助玩家理解GPU的工作原理。游戏背景源于开发者对计算机图形学教育的长期投入，设计初衷是让玩家在动手实践中掌握硬件知识。核心功能是玩家通过连线电路逐步构建GPU的各个模块，并用自定义电路计算和渲染屏幕上的图像，实现从基础到复杂的图形输出。亮点在于提供免费演示版，已能渲染三角形图形，展示了从零构建图形管线的直观过程，虽无具体性能数字，但强调渐进式学习体验。适用场景包括计算机图形学课程、硬件爱好者自学或作为编程教育工具，帮助用户深入理解渲染流水线。
items.quote: 在游戏中，你通过连接电路来一步步构建 GPU，并根据电路的计算结果在屏幕上渲染出画面。

items.title: Show HN: Quilt – a bright, modern take on identicons
items.desc: description: A quilt for every word: a small, bright picture you can use as an avatar. One URL, CORSenabled. title: quilt.id: a quilt for every word image: https://quilt.id/og.png []( "Scroll up to the quilt") Roll a word A quilt for every word. Type any word and get a small, bright, symmetric picture of it. Use it for avatars, commits, API keys, or anything else that needs a face. Each image is one URL, and you can embed it anywhere. Roll a word svgpng _×_ _+_ Prior art People have turned hashes into pictures for a long time. These projects inspired quilt.id. Each one below uses the project's algorithm to render the SHA1 of . 1999 · Perrig & Song [Random Art↗](https://people.eecs.berkeley.edu/~dawnsong/papers/randomart.pdf) Early research into converting cryptographic hashes into recognizable abstract images for human verification. 2008 · Alexander von Gernler [OpenSSH RandomArt↗](https://www.openbsd.org/openssh/) ASCIIart visualizations of SSH key fingerprints, using a deterministic random walk to create recognizable patterns. 2013 · GitHub [GitHub Identicons↗](https://github.blog/newsinsights/companynews/identicons/) Symmetric 5×5 pixel avatars generated from hashed user IDs, with a single hashderived foreground color. Type a user ID to see their avatar. 2014 · Alex Van de Sande [Blockies↗](https://github.com/ethereum/blockies) Colorful, blocky pixelart identities generated deterministically from seeds, popularized by Ethereum wallets. 2014 · Daniel Mester [Jdenticon↗](https://jdenticon.com/) Symmetric geometric identicons using hashderived shapes, carefully tuned saturation, and perceptually adjusted lightness. 2017 · Julian Fietkau [MosaicVisualHash↗](https://fietkau.software/mosaic%5Fvisual%5Fhash) Stainedglasslike visual hashes using harmonious color palettes, complementary hues, and constrained saturation and lightness. 2020 · Blockchain Commons [LifeHash↗](https://lifehash.info/) Colorful visual fingerprints generated using Conway’s Game of Life, deterministic symmetry, and coordinated palettes. 2026 · Carl Sverre [Quilt↓](encoding) Symmetric 5×5 pixel identities combining three harmonious colors selected through hashderived hue, scheme, tone, and chroma parameters. API One GET request returns one image. Pick a format and size, then copy the URL. FormatSVGPNG Size32 · favicon128256320400 · avatar Word Any text up to 255 characters, percentencoded with encodeURIComponent. Format & size SVG stays sharp at any size, so use it on web pages. Use PNG for avatar uploads and anywhere SVG isn't accepted. size is 32 to 400 pixels, default 256\. The URL must end in .svg or .png. Caching & CORS The v1 encoding is frozen, so a URL always returns the same image, cached for a year as immutable. Every response sends AccessControlAllowOrigin: . Encoding How the SHA1 of your word becomes a quilt. 1 SHA1 of the UTF8 input, first 48 of 160 bits The first 18 bits pick the palette. The next 30 bits are 15 cells, c1 to c15; c1 and c13 fall on the corners and are masked. Hover any part to find it elsewhere. 2 30 bits fill the grid 15 cells, 2 bits each: 00 is empty, and 01–11 pick a color. The left two columns are mirrored to the right. The corner cells are masked to empty whatever their bits say, so the quilt fits a circle crop.
items.author: carlsverre
items.descZh: quilt.id 是一个将任意单词转换为独特对称图像的创新服务，其设计灵感源于将哈希值可视化的历史项目，如 GitHub Identicons 和 Blockies。核心功能是用户输入一个单词，系统通过 SHA1 哈希算法生成一个 5×5 像素的明亮对称图案，确保每个词对应唯一视觉。亮点包括支持 SVG 和 PNG 格式，尺寸范围从 32 到 400 像素，SVG 在任何尺寸都保持清晰；每个图像对应一个 URL，支持 CORS 且可嵌入，缓存期长达一年，使用三种和谐色彩基于哈希参数精心调校。这种服务特别适合用作头像、代码提交记录图标或 API 密钥标识等需要个性化视觉的场景。
items.quote: 输入任意单词，即可获得一张小巧、明亮、对称的图片。

items.descZh: 传统国际象棋应用大多致力于还原经典的64格完整棋盘对战，而本产品则反其道而行之，将复杂的国际象棋规则拆解为针对移动端设计的微型游戏。其核心功能是通过更小的棋盘和碎片化（bite-sized）的课程（如Firstchess），将国际象棋的单一技能孤立出来进行游戏化设计，帮助用户循序渐进地学习基础知识。产品的亮点在于化整为零的教学策略，区别于传统的64格棋盘，它通过缩小棋盘规格，把复杂的全局博弈转化为针对单一技能的快速、趣味性训练，极大降低了新手的学习门槛。该产品特别适合初学者利用碎片化时间快速掌握核心规则，也适用于希望针对特定战术进行专项突破的玩家。
items.quote: 在过去的几年里，我一直在做相反的事情——将国际象棋分解为在较小的棋盘上进行的快速、小型的移动游戏，每个游戏都旨在隔离和博弈

items.author: winebarrel
items.descZh: hazel 是一款针对 SQLite 的声明式架构管理工具，借鉴了 Terraform 的计划与应用工作流。其核心功能允许用户通过声明式定义来管理数据库结构，并自动比对和同步实际状态与期望状态之间的差异。亮点在于其提供的类 Terraform 计划功能，能在应用变更前预览差异，提升操作安全性，特别适合需要版本控制和 CI/CD 集成的 SQLite 数据库管理场景。它适用于小型应用开发、嵌入式系统或任何以 SQLite 为核心存储且需要规范数据库变更流程的项目。
items.quote: Hazel 是一个用于 SQLite 的声明式 schema 管理工具，采用类似 Terraform 的 plan/apply 工作流。

items.author: tthanh2k6
items.descZh: turbobrowsermcp 是一款基于 Playwright 的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器，旨在通过将 25 至 33 种精细的浏览器原语整合为 10 种批量工具，来解决 LLM 浏览器自动化中的高 token 消耗与多轮延迟问题。其核心功能包括多标签页批量并行、紧凑增量 DOM 快照、React/Shadow DOM/iframe 表单预填、磁盘文件直传以及默认的人工提交防护。实测性能极其亮眼：10 字段复杂表单填充从传统的 11 轮交互缩减至仅 1 轮（耗时 82 毫秒，仅 811 token），速度提升 7 倍且累积 token 节省高达 98.9%；140 按钮的密集 UI 快照仅需 1,135 token，较原 HTML 节省 93.9%。此外，48 KiB 的 PDF 上传通过零 Base64 的磁盘路径实现了 99.8% 的 token 节省，而并发打开 6 个标签页相比顺序执行速度提升 2.38 倍，6 步交互式 UI 流程仅需 1 轮即可完成。该工具特别适用于对上下文窗口成本和执行延迟高度敏感的 LLM 智能体（Agent）场景，如复杂多步网页表单自动化、大规模并发数据抓取、无损页面诊断及 Markdown 内容抽取。
items.quote: Turbobrowsermcp 是一款基于 Playwright 的模型上下文协议 (MCP) 服务器，旨在减少浏览器自动化中的 LLM 令牌浪费和多轮延迟。

items.title: Show HN: PowerQueue free online message queue supports AWS, GCE, Azure, AMQP
items.desc: description: A free public message queue, no account required, that speaks AMQP 091, Amazon SQS, Google Cloud Pub/Sub, Azure Queue Storage and Azure Service Bus. No signup. No uptime guarantee. [Skip to content](content) A free message queue, no account required PowerQueue is a message queue that speaks AMQP 091, Amazon SQS, Google Cloud Pub/Sub, Azure Queue Storage and Azure Service Bus. This public service is free for anyone to use: point the official client library you already use at it, with an identifier you generate yourself. No signup, no account, no payment. No uptime guarantee, and no guarantee your data survives. The service is down for maintenance from time to time. Your queues and messages normally persist across those restarts, but nothing is backed up and data may be lost at any time, for example when a storage format changes. A message lives at most 1 hour, a tenant holds at most 16 MiB of messages, and a tenant with no activity for 7 days is deleted with everything in it. Use the service for learning, testing, demonstrations and hobby projects, never for anything you cannot afford to lose. Totally freeNo charges, no payment details, no paid tier. No account requiredNo signup, no email, no API keys. Your identifier is your tenant. Usage is logged, with client IP addresses ([terms](terms.htmlprivacy)). Five protocolsOfficial SDKs, unmodified: only the endpoint and credentials change. DisposableDown from time to time; no backups; messages live 1 hour; idle tenants deleted after 7 days. Live statistics Loading the latest figures… Queues created Messages sent Tenants created Idle tenants deleted Totals since . Queues include Pub/Sub topics and subscriptions and Service Bus topics and subscriptions. Tenants now Queues now Messages held now Running since . Last updated . Get an identifier Every request names a tenant identifier: 24 characters, a lowercase letter followed by 23 lowercase letters or digits. The first request that names an identifier creates its tenant; there is nothing to register. This page generates one in your browser from a cryptographically random source, without contacting the server. You may also make your own, as long as it is chosen at random. Your tenant identifier New identifier Copy Forget The identifier is the secret. There are no passwords: anyone who knows your identifier can read, send and delete everything in your tenant, and it appears in URLs and resource names. Keep it private, and never pick a memorable one. Quick start Thirty seconds per protocol. Each example sends a message and reads it back, in Python with the official library. The queue does not need to exist first: using a name creates it. The [documentation](docs/index.html) has more languages, every option and every error. AMQP 091 (RabbitMQ clients) The virtual host is your identifier; any user name and password. Port 5673, TLS. pip install pika import pika url = "amqps://user:password@amqp.powerqueue.link:5673/<youridentifier" with pika.BlockingConnection(pika.URLParameters(url)) as connection: channel = connection.channel() channel.basic_publish(exchange="", routing_key="helloamqp", body=b"Hello, world") method, properties, body = channel.basic_get("helloamqp", auto_ack=True) print(body) [AMQP 091 guide](docs/amqp.html) Amazon SQS The access key id is your identifier; any secret key and region. pip install boto3 import boto3 sqs = boto3.client( "sqs", endpoint_url="https://sqs.powerqueue.link", region_name="useast1", aws_access_key_id="<youridentifier", aws_secret_access_key="anything", ) url = sqs.get_queue_url(QueueName="hellosqs")["QueueUrl"] sqs.send_message(QueueUrl=url, MessageBody="Hello, world") for message in sqs.receive_message(QueueUrl=url, WaitTimeSeconds=5).get("Messages", []): print(message["Body"]) sqs.delete_message(QueueUrl=url, ReceiptHandle=message["ReceiptHandle"]) [SQS guide](docs/sqs.html) Google Cloud Pub/Sub The project id is your identifier; no credentials. Publishing to topic hellopubsub also creates subscription hellopubsub. pip install googlecloudpubsub from google.api_core.client_options import ClientOptions from google.auth.credentials import AnonymousCredentials from google.cloud import pubsub_v1 project = "<youridentifier" options = ClientOptions(api_endpoint="pubsub.powerqueue.link:443") publisher = pubsub_v1.PublisherClient(credentials=AnonymousCredentials(), client_options=options) subscriber = pubsub_v1.SubscriberClient(credentials=AnonymousCredentials(), client_options=options) publisher.publish(publisher.topic_path(project, "hellopubsub"), b"Hello, world").result() subscription = subscriber.subscription_path(project, "hellopubsub") response = subscriber.pull(subscription=subscription, max_messages=10) for received in response.received_messages: print(received.message.data) subscriber.acknowledge(subscription=subscription, ack_ids=[r.ack_id for r in response.received_messages]) [Pub/Sub guide](docs/pubsub.html) Azure Queue Storage The account name is your identifier, as the first part of the URL path; any base64 account key. pip install azurestoragequeue from azure.storage.queue import QueueClient queue = QueueClient( account_url="https://azure.powerqueue.link/<youridentifier", queue_name="helloazure", credential={"account_name": "<youridentifier", "account_key": "YW55dGhpbmc="}, ) queue.send_message("Hello, world") for message in queue.receive_messages(): print(message.content) queue.delete_message(message) [Azure Queue Storage guide](docs/azurequeue.html) Azure Service Bus The shared access key name is your identifier; any key. pip install azureservicebus from azure.servicebus import ServiceBusClient, ServiceBusMessage connection_string = ( "Endpoint=sb://amqp.powerqueue.link/;" "SharedAccessKeyName=<youridentifier;SharedAccessKey=anything" ) with ServiceBusClient.from_connection_string(connection_string) as client: with client.get_queue_sender("helloservicebus") as sender: sender.send_messages(ServiceBusMessage("Hello, world")) with client.get

items.descZh: PowerQueue是一个免费的公共消息队列服务，无需注册账户，支持AMQP 091、Amazon SQS、Google Cloud Pub/Sub、Azure Queue Storage和Azure Service Bus等多种协议。用户只需使用自生成的标识符和现有官方客户端库即可快速接入，无需支付费用或进行复杂配置。该服务的亮点在于完全免费且协议兼容性强，但性能有限制，如消息最多存活1小时，每个租户最多存储16 MiB数据，无活动租户7天后删除。适用于学习、测试、演示和业余项目等场景，不适合关键业务或不能承受数据丢失的应用。
